basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software developer based in Austin, Texas. I've always had a passion for technology and gaming, which is why I spend most of my free time exploring new gadgets and playing video games. I got into Reddit about a year and a half ago, initially to follow VR developments and quickly found myself drawn to various communities that align with my hobbies. I work remotely, which gives me the flexibility to browse Reddit during late evenings. I'm currently single, and my weekends are often spent either on gaming marathons or working on my slot car tracks.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a Bachelor's degree in Computer Science and a few years of experience in the tech industry, I have a solid foundation in software development. My interest in virtual reality led me to self-teach various aspects of VR technology. Additionally, I have a longstanding interest in gaming, particularly in niche areas like slot cars and retro gaming.
